request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; Architecture assessment by Q3 2027; IOG contract noted as closing August 31, 2026
deliverables: Protocol maintenance, node and wallet backend updates, hard fork readiness, and compatible stable releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, plus newer hardware wallet models as they emerge during the contract period
CIP-30 dApp connector implementation within Daedalus with documentation and interoperability verification
Responsive user support, including Japanese-language support and full Japanese translation across shipped features
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc., administered through Intersect with milestone-based monthly disbursement controls.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Daedalus Wallet maintenance and improvements for 2026-2027 as a time-and-materials engagement delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet and derives wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, with the proposer asserting the true count is higher.

Se7en Labs assumed responsibility for Daedalus under an IOG contract in January 2026 and has shipped Mithril snapshot bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, a release CLI, and Nix build modernization since then.
The proposal commits to stable Daedalus releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork and to keeping cardano-node no more than 2 major versions behind the mainnet recommendation.
All release-timing and version-currency metrics are claimed to be independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.

The work package total is 1,785,333 ADA, consisting of 1,666,667 ADA for maintenance and improvements, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and a 52,000 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.
The proposer states the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Intersect is proposed to administer the funds, independently verify milestones, hold funds in a dedicated auditable account, and disburse monthly against verified work.
Se7en Labs states it has not received ADA from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 1,785,333 ADA for one year of Daedalus maintenance, protocol compatibility, feature additions, user support, audit, hardware, and administration, with Intersect oversight and several delivery metrics framed as publicly verifiable.
